import { storage, themeGet, themeOnChanged, type Subscription, type Theme } from '@napplet/sdk';
import { runtimeHasDomain } from './domain-availability.js';
import './styles.css';

const root = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#app');
if (!root) throw new Error('APP_ROOT_MISSING');
const editor = document.createElement('textarea');
editor.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Note');
editor.dataset.nappletSelect = 'text';
editor.placeholder = 'Write a note';
const toolbar = document.createElement('div');
toolbar.className = 'toolbar';
const save = document.createElement('button');
save.type = 'button'; save.textContent = 'Save';
const status = document.createElement('output');
status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
toolbar.append(save, status); root.replaceChildren(editor, toolbar);

// The storage-less run is the conformance degradation fixture. A real host
// enforces the hard requirement before loading a normal placement.
if (runtimeHasDomain('storage')) {
  storage.getItem('note').then(value => { editor.value = value ?? ''; }).catch(() => { status.textContent = 'Could not load the saved note'; });
  save.addEventListener('click', () => {
    save.disabled = true;
    storage.setItem('note', editor.value).then(() => { status.textContent = 'Saved'; }).catch(() => { status.textContent = 'Could not save'; }).finally(() => { save.disabled = false; });
  });
} else { save.disabled = true; status.textContent = 'Saving is unavailable; edits stay in this view'; }

function applyTheme(theme: Theme): void {
  const style = document.documentElement.style;
  style.setProperty('--bg', theme.colors.background);
  style.setProperty('--fg', theme.colors.text);
  style.setProperty('--primary', theme.colors.primary);
}
let subscription: Subscription | undefined;
if (runtimeHasDomain('theme')) {
  themeGet().then(applyTheme).catch(() => undefined);
  subscription = themeOnChanged(applyTheme);
}
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => subscription?.close(), { once: true });
